instructors.rosterEmpty: This academy has no instructors yet. Add one from Academy Members first.

settings.title: Course Settings
settings.subtitle: Manage status, visibility and publishing
settings.publishingDescription: Published courses are visible to students and open for enrollment.

publishDialog.title: Publish this course?
publishDialog.descriptionWithCurriculum: Your course will become visible according to its configured visibility.
publishDialog.descriptionNoCurriculum: This course doesn't have any curriculum yet. You can still publish it and add lessons later.

settings.dangerZoneDescription: Deleting a course is permanent and removes it for every enrolled student.

deleteCourseConfirm.title: Delete this course?
deleteCourseConfirm.description: This will permanently delete "{{title}}" and its entire curriculum. This cannot be undone.

completion.title: Completion and certificate
completion.description: What a learner must do to complete this course, and whether a certificate is issued for it.

all.label: All published lessons
all.description: Every published lesson must be completed.

none.label: No lesson requirement
none.description: Only quizzes, assignments and the minimum score, if set, count.

min.label: At least this many lessons
min.description: Any published lessons count towards the number.

quizzes.label: Required quizzes
quizzes.description: The learner must pass each quiz ticked below.
quizzes.empty: This course has no quizzes yet.

assignments.label: Required assignments
assignments.description: The learner must have each assignment ticked below graded.
assignments.empty: This course has no assignments yet.

minOverallScore.label: Minimum overall score (%)
minOverallScore.description: The average of the kept quiz scores and assignment grades must reach this. Leave empty for no minimum.

certificates.label: Issue a certificate
certificates.description: A certificate is issued automatically when the learner completes the course and meets the minimum score below.
certificates.featureDisabled: Certificates are not enabled for this academy yet.

certificateMinScore.label: Minimum score for the certificate (%)
certificateMinScore.description: Leave empty to issue on completion alone.

completion.ownerOrManagerOnly: Only academy owners and managers can change these settings.

assignmentAuthoring.title: Assignments
assignmentAuthoring.subtitle: Author the assignments students submit for this course
assignmentAuthoring.empty: This course has no assignments yet.
assignmentAuthoring.emptyDescription: Add an assignment for students to submit work against.

dialog.allowResubmissionDescription: Students may submit again after their first submission.

help.status: Draft assignments are visible only to you. Students can only see and submit an assignment once it is published.
help.dueAt: Shown to students as the deadline. What happens after it depends on the late policy below.
help.latePolicy: Only matters when a due date is set. The server enforces it; the student sees it on the assignment before submitting.

latePolicy.accept_flagged: Accept late submissions and flag them

latePolicyDescription.block: Enforced: after the due date the submit action is refused and the student is told the deadline has passed.
latePolicyDescription.accept_flagged: Recorded: submissions after the due date are accepted and marked as late for reviewers.

dialog.requiredForCompletionDescription: Counts towards the course completion rule when "required assignments" is on in the course settings.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete this assignment?
deleteConfirm.description: This will permanently delete "{{title}}" and any student submissions against it. This cannot be undone.

quizAuthoring.title: Quizzes
quizAuthoring.subtitle: Author the quizzes students take for this course
quizAuthoring.empty: This course has no quizzes yet.
quizAuthoring.emptyDescription: Add a quiz to test what students have learned.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete this quiz?
deleteConfirm.description: This will permanently delete "{{title}}" and any student attempts against it. This cannot be undone.

help.status: Draft quizzes are visible only to you. Students can only see and attempt a quiz once it is published.
help.passingScore: The percentage a student needs to pass. Leave it empty if this quiz has no pass mark — every submitted attempt then counts as passed.
help.maxAttempts: How many times a student may take this quiz. Leave it empty for unlimited attempts.
help.points: How much this question is worth, 0 to 100. The score is the points earned divided by the points available.
help.relatedLesson: Optional. Shown with the review so a learner who missed this question knows where to go back to.
help.acceptedAnswers: Up to 20 answers of up to 200 characters each. The learner’s text is compared case-insensitively to each one.
help.explanation: Optional, up to 2000 characters. Shown with the review only when "Show explanations" is on and the results policy allows answers.

editor.explanationPlaceholder: Optional. Shown with the review when the results policy allows it.
editor.essayNote: Essay answers are graded manually by a reviewer. The attempt stays "Awaiting grading" until every essay in it has been graded.
editor.acceptedAnswersHelp: Any one of these counts as correct. Matching ignores capitalisation and surrounding spaces.

validation.trueFalseOptionCount: A True/False question needs exactly two options.
validation.exactlyOneCorrect: Mark exactly one option as correct.
validation.atLeastOneCorrect: Mark at least one option as correct.
validation.acceptedAnswerRequired: Add at least one accepted answer.
validation.availabilityOrder: The closing time must be after the opening time.

settings.title: Settings
settings.presetsHelp: Start from a preset, then change anything below.

practice.label: Practice
practice.description: No time limit, results and answers shown immediately, nothing recorded. Good for self-checks.

exam.label: Exam
exam.description: 30-minute limit, one question per page, score after the due date, answers never shown, learners warned about recorded events.

presets.custom: Custom settings. Pick a preset to reset every setting below.

disclosure.after_attempts_exhausted: After the last attempt is used

timing.title: Timing and availability
timing.description: When the quiz can be taken and how long an attempt may last. The server is the clock: limits are enforced from its time, not the learner’s device.

attempts.title: Attempts and grading
attempts.description: How many attempts a learner gets and how they turn into one score.

results.title: Results and review
results.description: What a learner sees after submitting. Correct answers are never sent to the learner before the policy allows.

integrity.title: Integrity
integrity.description: What is recorded during an attempt and what happens when the limit is reached. Nothing here prevents a learner from switching tabs or copying: events are recorded and reported to reviewers.

progression.title: Progression
progression.description: How this quiz gates the rest of the course.

mode.label: Mode
mode.description: Enforced: exam mode requests fullscreen when integrity is on and shows the attempt one question at a time by default.

timeLimit.label: Time limit (minutes)
timeLimit.description: Enforced: when time runs out the saved answers are submitted automatically and graded as they are. Leave empty for no limit.

availableFrom.label: Opens
availableFrom.description: Enforced: attempts cannot start before this time. Leave empty to open as soon as the quiz is published.

availableUntil.label: Closes
availableUntil.description: Enforced: attempts cannot start after this time and open attempts end here at the latest.

dueAt.label: Due
dueAt.description: Recorded: attempts submitted after this time are marked late and handled by the late policy.

latePolicy.label: Late policy
latePolicy.description: What happens to an attempt started after the due date.

options.accept_flagged: Allow late attempts and flag them

hideTimer.label: Hide the countdown
hideTimer.description: The digits are hidden; the limit is still enforced and the learner is still told when time is nearly up and when it has run out.

passingScore.description: Enforced: the percentage needed to pass. Leave empty if there is no pass mark; every submitted attempt then counts as passed.

maxAttempts.description: Enforced: how many attempts a learner may start. Leave empty for unlimited attempts.

gradingPolicy.label: Score to keep
gradingPolicy.description: Which attempt becomes the learner’s score for completion and certificates.

questionsPerAttempt.label: Questions per attempt
questionsPerAttempt.description: Each attempt draws this many questions from the pool. Leave empty to ask every question.

shuffleQuestions.label: Shuffle questions
shuffleQuestions.description: Each attempt gets its own question order, fixed for that attempt.

shuffleOptions.label: Shuffle options
shuffleOptions.description: Each attempt gets its own option order within a question. True/False questions are never shuffled.

layout.label: Layout
layout.description: On small screens one question per page is used regardless.

showScore.label: Show the score
showScore.description: When the learner sees their score and pass/fail result.

showAnswers.label: Show the correct answers
showAnswers.description: When the learner sees which answers were correct. Never sent before this moment.

showExplanations.label: Show explanations
showExplanations.description: Shown with the correct answers, so this follows the "show the correct answers" policy.

descriptions.monitor: Tab switches, focus loss, fullscreen exits, copy, paste and printing are recorded and shown to reviewers. The learner is not warned.
descriptions.warn: Tab switches, focus loss, fullscreen exits, copy, paste and printing are recorded and shown to reviewers, and the learner is warned with the count each time.
descriptions.strict: Tab switches, focus loss, fullscreen exits, copy, paste and printing are recorded and shown to reviewers, the learner is warned with the count, and the attempt is submitted automatically when the limit is reached.

maxViolations.label: Violation limit
maxViolations.descriptionMonitor: Recorded only: attempts at or above this count are flagged for reviewers. Nothing happens to the learner.
maxViolations.descriptionWarn: The learner is told how many of these remain. Attempts at or above this count are flagged for reviewers; nothing is submitted automatically.
maxViolations.descriptionStrict: Enforced: reaching this count submits the attempt automatically and flags it for reviewers.

requireFullscreen.label: Ask for fullscreen
requireFullscreen.description: The attempt requests fullscreen when it starts. Leaving fullscreen is recorded as an event; it is not blocked.

requiredToProgress.label: Required to continue
requiredToProgress.description: Enforced: the activities after this quiz stay locked until it is passed.

requiredForCompletion.label: Required for course completion
requiredForCompletion.description: Counts towards the course completion rule when "required quizzes" is on in the course settings.

preview.title: Student preview
preview.description: What a learner sees when the attempt opens: no correct answers, options in the order above, every control read-only.
preview.emptyPrompt: This question has no prompt yet.
